Termux - Not just a terminal emulator for your Android

Glow

2025-01-05

09.1.2025

Agenda

  • What even is Termux?
  • Installing software
  • Service management

Installing software

pkg? apt?

apt, basically

Installing software

So what does pkg install do?

It does 3 things:

  • Selecting a working mirror:

termux-change-repo

  • Updateing package index:

apt update

  • Installing the requested package

apt install $@

Installing software

So about installing software?

~ $ pkg install nano

Or, if you're a pro

~ $ apt install vim

But remember to run apt update first and occasionally.

So it is basically Debian?

No systemd here!

Based on runit?

Service Management

  1. Install termux-services 
    ~ $ apt install termux-services
  1. Start the service daemon. 
    ~ $ service-daemon start

    Or restart Termux, because the service daemon autostarts

  1. Install a package that provides a service 
    ~ $ apt install openssh

Service Management

  1. Start/stop a service 
    ~ $ sv up sshd
~ $ sv status sshd
run: sshd: (pid 10436) 14s, normally down; run: log: (pid 27794) 407s
~ $ sv down sshd
  1. Autostart a service 
    ~ $ sv-enable sshd
~ $ sv status sshd
run: sshd: (pid 10436) 140s; run: log: (pid 27794) 533s
  1. Check log files 
    ~ $ cat $LOGDIR/sv/sshd/current
2025-01-05_14:44:47.27061 Server listening on :: port 8022.
2025-01-05_14:44:47.27100 Server listening on 0.0.0.0 port 8022.

Access Termux via USB

  1. Enable usb debugging
  1. Install adb
  1. Forward sshd port 
    glow@stinkpad:~$ adb forward tcp:8022 tcp:8022
  1. Conenct via ssh to local port 
    glow@stinkpad:~$ ssh localhost -p 8022
  1. Authenticate for the first time 
    
~ $ passwd
New password:
Retype new password:
New password was successfully set.
